variants.title: A Time for Us · Fabrizio Caligaris

description.uz: Romeo & Juliet muhabbat mavzusining Fabrizio Caligaris ijrosi. Darslar alohida original variantga tegishli.
description.ru: Исполнение темы любви Romeo & Juliet от Fabrizio Caligaris. Уроки относятся к отдельной исходной версии.
description.en: Fabrizio Caligaris's performance of the Romeo & Juliet love theme. The lessons follow the separate original edition.

variants.original_filename: A Time For Us (Romeo And Juliet Love Theme) - Piano Tutorial - PDF.mid
variants.intro_review: Opening belongs to the musical arrangement; no unrelated channel jingle identified.

difficulty_review.basis: Melody over a moving broken-chord accompaniment; wide register shifts and a denser middle require independent hands and phrase control.

variants.title: Patrik Pietschmann

description.uz: Takroriy puls, keng registr va zichroq fakturali aranjirovka.
description.ru: Аранжировка с повторяющимся пульсом, широким регистром и более плотной фактурой.
description.en: An arrangement with a repeated pulse, broad register and denser texture.

variants.original_filename: Interstellar - Main Theme [Piano Tutorial Synthesia] (Patrik Pietschmann).mid
variants.intro_review: Opening belongs to the musical arrangement; no unrelated channel jingle identified.

difficulty_review.basis: Repeated-note pulse must remain even under a sustained upper voice; later wide bass movement and dense rapid patterns require advanced coordination.

variants.title: The Piano Lab

description.uz: Ixchamroq fakturadagi, alohida ijro tempi va tuzilishiga ega variant.
description.ru: Версия с более прозрачной фактурой, собственным темпом и формой исполнения.
description.en: A more transparent texture with its own performance tempo and structure.

variants.original_filename: How To Play _Interstellar_ Main Theme by Hans Zimmer, Piano Tutorial, Synthesia [THE PIANO LAB].mid
variants.intro_review: Opening belongs to the musical arrangement; no unrelated channel jingle identified.

difficulty_review.basis: Fewer attacks and a narrower upper range than the Pietschmann performance; layered chords and melody still require steady pulse and hand balance.

variants.title: Aldy Tutorials

description.uz: Simon & Garfunkel qo‘shig‘i. Siz so‘raganidek yarim ton pastga transpozitsiya qilingan.
description.ru: Песня Simon & Garfunkel. По вашему запросу транспонирована на полтона вниз.
description.en: The Simon & Garfunkel song, transposed down one semitone as requested.

variants.original_filename: The Sound of Silence - Simon and Garfunkel (Piano Tutorial) (3).mid
variants.intro_review: Opening belongs to the musical arrangement; no unrelated channel jingle identified.

difficulty_review.basis: Melody and repeated broken-chord accompaniment grow into a dense texture with bass shifts and multi-note voicing; requires independent balance and relaxed movement.

variants.transpose_reason: User requested minus one semitone. Ivory's toolbar transpose did not affect its Performance MIDI download; note-on/off pitches were shifted offline, retaining all original timing, holds, velocities and non-note messages.
